title: Lima Patani lima bean (Beans Lima Patani): Characteristics
metaDescription: Lima Patani lima bean is a garden packet (type not stated) lima bean variety. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: Lima Patani lima bean is a garden packet (type not stated) lima bean variety, also sold or known as Beans Lima Patani or Patani. It is not a registered variety, so the facts here come from its seller and farm sources. It comes from Ramgo.

heroImage.alt: Young mungbean rows beside paddy fields in Candaba, Pampanga, the kind of farm where Lima Patani lima bean is grown

blocks.text: If you came here looking for Beans Lima Patani or Patani, this is the same lima bean. The facts below come from its seller and from farm sources, each one listed at the end. Compare it with the others in our [lima bean variety finder](/crop-varieties/lima-bean), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Land preparation for legumes](/land-preparation/legume-land-preparation).
Key facts about Lima Patani lima bean

blocks.caption: From its seller and farm sources
rows: Beans Lima Patani, Patani, Ramgo patani
Days to harvest, per the seller
70 to 75 days after sowing per the planting guide (the product page says 60 to 65), keeps bearing up to 5 months

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

No day count or trial yield is published for this variety. So ask the seller or your municipal agriculturist for figures from farms near you before you plan a season around it.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
No pest or disease ratings are published for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit lima bean fields most often: [anthracnose](/diseases/anthracnose), [bean fly](/pests/bean-fly), [legume pod borer](/pests/legume-pod-borer), [powdery mildew](/diseases/powdery-mildew). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Days to harvest:** 70 to 75 days after sowing per the planting guide (the product page says 60 to 65), keeps bearing up to 5 months.
**Fruit:** Green pods ready to pick 7 to 10 days after flowering.
Guide gives a mean monthly temperature of 15 to 24 C.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: sold as a Ramgo garden seed packet. These are the seller's own figures, from its own trials. So plant a small area first, and compare it with your usual lima bean on the same ground.
Where and when to plant Lima Patani lima bean

Patani climbs and bears for a long time. Pick a variety by seed size and color, and give it a strong trellis. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Pagtatanim ng gulay](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-gulay).

items: Buy sealed packs or tagged sacks from an accredited dealer, and check the packing date and germination rate.
Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.
Try it on a small area first, beside the variety you usually plant, before you switch the whole farm.
Write down the planting day, inputs and harvest, so you can compare varieties on your own ground. anee.io keeps these records for you.

items.q: Is Beans Lima Patani the same as Lima Patani?
items.a: Yes. Beans Lima Patani is another name for Lima Patani. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Lima Patani?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
